description: This file contains interface and class implementations for data repositories related to customers, outages, and jobs within a backend outage management system. It defines repository interfaces and their concrete implementations using Dapper for database access, managing CRUD operations, transaction handling, and data retrieval logic.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ICustomerRepository for accessing customer data.

classes.name: OutageRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IOutageRepository for managing outage records and related data.

classes.name: JobRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IJobRepository for handling job records and status events.

methods.name: GetCustomerByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their user ID.

methods.name: SearchCustomersAsync
methods.description: Searches for customers matching a query within an organization.

methods.name: GetOutageAsync
methods.description: Fetches an outage by its ID.

methods.name: ListOutagesAsync
methods.description: Lists outages for an organization with optional filters for status and severity.

methods.name: CreateOutageAsync
methods.description: Creates a new outage record along with location data and initial update.

methods.name: UpdateOutageStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing outage.

methods.name: AddOutageUpdateAsync
methods.description: Adds an update entry to an outage's timeline.

methods.name: GetOutageUpdatesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves updates for a specific outage.

methods.name: GetJobAsync
methods.description: Fetches a job by its ID.

methods.name: ListJobsAsync
methods.description: Lists jobs for an organization with optional filters.

methods.name: CreateJobAsync
methods.description: Creates a new job and logs initial status event.

methods.name: AssignJobAsync
methods.description: Assigns a crew and user to a job and updates its status.

methods.name: UpdateJobStatusAsync
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing job.

methods.name: GetJobStatusEventsAsync
methods.description: Fetches status change events for a job.
